arguments:
test "$(cat /input/file)" = nautilus-podsandbox-parity-v1
/bin/busybox setsid /bin/sh -ec '
  trap "" HUP TERM
  awk "\$1 == \$6 { detached = 1 } END { exit !detached }" "/proc/$$/stat"
  printf ready > /workspace/timeout.started
  exec 3>>/workspace/timeout.heartbeat
  while :; do printf x >&3; sleep 1; done
' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
child=$!
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  if test -s /workspace/timeout.started; then
    printf 'timeout-ready\n'
    wait "$child"
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 1
done
echo 'Detached child did not become ready' >&2
exit 1
